about.registryInfo: Justoken (rebranded from Agrotoken, April 2025), founded 2020, HQ Buenos Aires, operating in Brazil and Argentina; founders Eduardo Novillo Astrada and Ariel Scaliter. Tokens are ERC-1155 commodity claims used for barter and credit collateral in the agricultural ecosystem; backing claimed via platform reconciliation of agricultural receipts (no public third-party auditor found).
